acquisition_method: The mass spectrometer was operated in positive ionization mode using a data dependent acquisition method.
cleavage_agent: Histones samples were quantified by the BCA method and 10 ̷g of each sample were derivatized with propionic anhydride, digested with trypsin and derivatized again with phenylisocyanate as previously described.
fragmentation_method: A 2-̷g aliquot of the peptide mixture was analyzed using a LTQ-Orbitrap Fusion Lumos mass spec-trometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific, San Jose, CA) coupled to an EASY-nLC 1000 (Thermo Fisher Scientific, San Jose, CA) with both collision induced dissociation (CID) and high energy collision dissociation (HCD) fragmentation.

instrument.evidence: A 2-̷g aliquot of the peptide mixture was analyzed using a LTQ-Orbitrap Fusion Lumos mass spec-trometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific, San Jose, CA) coupled to an EASY-nLC 1000 (Thermo Fisher Scientific, San Jose, CA) with both collision induced dissociation (CID) and high energy collision dissociation (HCD) fragmentation.

labeling: inferred: Acquired data were analyzed using the Proteome Discoverer software suite (v2.0, Thermo Fisher Scientific), and the Mascot search engine (v2.6, Matrix Science) was used for peptide identification using a double-search strategy.
